+ import type { Command } from "commander";
+ import chalk from "chalk";
+ import * as path from "path";
+ import * as inquirer from "inquirer";
+ import ora from "ora";
+ import * as fs from "fs";
+ import * as glob from "glob";
+ import type { DataTypeConfig } from "../config";
+ import {
+ 	BucketType,
+ 	createMetadata,
+ 	writeMetadata,
+ 	moveFile,
+ 	getModelBucketPath,
+ } from "../lib/bucketManager";
+ import { getModelNames } from "../lib/modelRegistry";
+ 
+ /**
+  * Register onboarding commands with Commander
+  * @param program The Commander program instance
+  */
+ export default function registerOnboardingCommands(program: Command): void {
+ 	// Onboard:discover command - Discover new files in source directories and add to backlog
+ 	program
+ 		.command("onboard:discover")
+ 		.description("Discover new files in source directories and add to backlog")
+ 		.option(
+ 			"-t, --type &lt;type&gt;",
+ 			"Type of data (testimonies, events, personnel, etc.)",
+ 		)
+ 		.option("-s, --source &lt;source&gt;", "Source directory path to scan")
+ 		.option(
+ 			"-p, --pattern &lt;pattern&gt;",
+ 			'File pattern to match (e.g., "*.md", "*.json")',
+ 		)
+ 		.option("-i, --interactive", "Run in interactive mode for file selection")
+ 		.action(async (options) =&gt; {
+ 			try {
+ 				// If no type is provided, prompt the user
+ 				const dataType = options.type || (await promptForDataType());
+ 				if (!dataType) return;
+ 
+ 				// Get source directory
+ 				const sourceDir = options.source || (await promptForSourceDirectory());
+ 				if (!sourceDir) {
+ 					console.log(chalk.yellow("No source directory provided"));
+ 					return;
+ 				}
+ 
+ 				// Default pattern is all files
+ 				const pattern = options.pattern || "*";
+ 
+ 				// Show spinner
+ 				const spinner = ora(
+ 					&#96;Discovering ${pattern} files in ${sourceDir} for ${dataType}...&#96;,
+ 				).start();
+ 
+ 				// Find files
+ 				const files = await findSourceFiles(sourceDir, pattern);
+ 				spinner.succeed(
+ 					&#96;Found ${files.length} files in ${sourceDir} matching "${pattern}"&#96;,
+ 				);
+ 
+ 				if (files.length === 0) {
+ 					console.log(
+ 						chalk.yellow(
+ 							&#96;No files found in ${sourceDir} matching pattern "${pattern}"&#96;,
+ 						),
+ 					);
+ 					return;
+ 				}
+ 
+ 				let filesToProcess = files;
+ 
+ 				// If interactive mode is enabled, let user select files
+ 				if (options.interactive) {
+ 					const { selectedFiles } = await inquirer.prompt([
+ 						{
+ 							type: "checkbox",
+ 							name: "selectedFiles",
+ 							message: "Select files to onboard:",
+ 							choices: files.map((file) =&gt; ({
+ 								name: &#96;${file.name} (${formatFileSize(file.size)})&#96;,
+ 								value: file.path,
+ 								checked: true,
+ 							})),
+ 						},
+ 					]);
+ 
+ 					filesToProcess = files.filter((file) =&gt;
+ 						selectedFiles.includes(file.path),
+ 					);
+ 					console.log(
+ 						chalk.blue(
+ 							&#96;Selected ${filesToProcess.length} files for onboarding&#96;,
+ 						),
+ 					);
+ 				}
+ 
+ 				// Process selected files
+ 				for (const file of filesToProcess) {
+ 					const spinnerFile = ora(&#96;Onboarding ${file.name}...&#96;).start();
+ 
+ 					try {
+ 						// Read file content
+ 						const content = fs.readFileSync(file.path, "utf8");
+ 
+ 						// Create target path
+ 						const targetPath = path.join(
+ 							getModelBucketPath(dataType.toString(), BucketType.BACKLOG),
+ 							file.name,
+ 						);
+ 
+ 						// Write file to backlog
+ 						fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(targetPath), { recursive: true });
+ 						fs.writeFileSync(targetPath, content);
+ 
+ 						// Create metadata
+ 						const metadata = createMetadata(
+ 							dataType.toString(),
+ 							file.name,
+ 							file.path,
+ 						);
+ 
+ 						// Add additional metadata
+ 						metadata.status = "new";

+ 			}

+ 
+ 	// Onboard:process command - Move files from backlog to processing
+ 	program
+ 		.command("onboard:process")
+ 		.description("Move files from backlog to processing stage")

+ 		)
+ 		.option("-f, --file &lt;file&gt;", "Specific file to process")
+ 		.option("-i, --interactive", "Run in interactive mode with file selection")
+ 		.action(async (options) =&gt; {
+ 			try {
+ 				// If no type is provided, prompt the user
+ 				const dataType = options.type || (await promptForDataType());
+ 				if (!dataType) return;
+ 
+ 				// Get files to process
+ 				let filesToProcess: string[] = [];

+ 				if (options.file) {

+ 						BucketType.BACKLOG,

+ 					filesToProcess = [path.join(backlogPath, options.file)];
+ 				} else if (options.interactive) {
+ 					// Interactive mode - let user select files
+ 					filesToProcess = await promptForBucketFiles(
+ 						dataType.toString(),
+ 						BucketType.BACKLOG,

+ 					if (filesToProcess.length === 0) {
+ 						console.log(chalk.yellow("No files selected for processing"));
+ 						return;
+ 					}
+ 				} else {
+ 					// Get all files in backlog
+ 					const backlogPath = getModelBucketPath(
+ 						dataType.toString(),

+ 					);
+ 					const files = fs

+ 					filesToProcess = files;

+ /**
+  * Find files in a source directory matching a pattern
+  * @param sourceDir Source directory
+  * @param pattern File pattern to match
+  * @returns Array of file info objects
+  */
+ async function findSourceFiles(
+ 	sourceDir: string,
+ 	pattern: string,
+ ): Promise&lt;Array&lt;{ name: string; path: string; size: number }&gt;&gt; {
+ 	return new Promise((resolve, reject) =&gt; {
+ 		const globPattern = path.join(sourceDir, pattern);
+ 
+ 		glob(globPattern, (err, matches) =&gt; {
+ 			if (err) {
+ 				reject(err);
+ 				return;
+ 			}
+ 
+ 			const files = matches
+ 				.filter((filePath) =&gt; fs.statSync(filePath).isFile())
+ 				.map((filePath) =&gt; ({
+ 					name: path.basename(filePath),
+ 					path: filePath,
+ 					size: fs.statSync(filePath).size,
+ 				}));
+ 
+ 			resolve(files);
+ 		});
+ 	});
+ }

+ 	if (bytes &lt; 1024 * 1024 * 1024)

_**Agent**_

Great! We've successfully created the "onboard" command module with two commands:

1. `onboard:discover` - Discovers files in source directories and adds them to the backlog bucket
2. `onboard:process` - Moves files from the backlog bucket to the processing bucket

This implementation allows users to:
- Discover files from external source directories
- Selectively choose which files to onboard
- Automatically create appropriate metadata for each file
- Move files between different stages of the processing pipeline
- Use interactive prompts for user-friendly operation

These commands integrate seamlessly with the existing CLI commands for processing, reviewing, and inserting data. The workflow is now complete:

1. Discover new files with `onboard:discover`
2. Move files to processing with `onboard:process`
3. Transform files with `process:transform`
4. Review files before insertion
5. Insert data into the database

The implementation leverages the modules we previously created:
- `bucketManager.ts` - For file operations across different buckets
- `modelRegistry.ts` - For accessing model information and validation
- Various other utility functions for file operations

Users can run the CLI with `ut-cli onboard:discover` and `ut-cli onboard:process` to use these new commands.

+ 		cmdArgs.push("--interactive");
+ 	}
+ 
+ 	if (!interactive &amp;&amp; (command === "transform" || command === "enhance")) {
+ 		const { file } = await inquirer.prompt([
+ 			{
+ 				type: "input",
+ 				name: "file",
+ 				message: "Enter specific file to process (leave empty for all files):",
+ 			},
+ 		]);
+ 
+ 		if (file) {
+ 			cmdArgs.push("--file", file);
+ 		}
+ 	}
+ 
+ 	if (command === "list") {
+ 		const { pattern } = await inquirer.prompt([
+ 			{
+ 				type: "input",
+ 				name: "pattern",
+ 				message: "Enter file pattern (leave empty for all files):",
+ 				default: "*",
+ 			},
+ 		]);
+ 
+ 		if (pattern !== "*") {
+ 			cmdArgs.push("--pattern", pattern);
+ 		}
+ 	}
+ 
+ 	// Execute the command
+ 	process.argv = [process.argv[0], process.argv[1], ...cmdArgs];
+ 	program.parse(process.argv);
+ 
+ 	// Return to menu after command completes
+ 	const { returnToMenu } = await inquirer.prompt([
+ 		{
+ 			type: "confirm",
+ 			name: "returnToMenu",
+ 			message: "Return to main menu?",
+ 			default: true,
+ 		},
+ 	]);
+ 
+ 	if (returnToMenu) {
+ 		return showInteractiveMenu();
+ 	}
+ }

+ /**
+  * Check database connection status
+  * @returns True if connection is successful, false otherwise
+  */
+ export async function checkConnection(): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {
+ 	try {
+ 		// Attempt to get client
+ 		const xata = getXataClient();
+ 
+ 		// Try a simple query to verify connection
+ 		const testRecord = await xata.db.testimonies.filter({}).getFirst();
+ 
+ 		// If we got here, connection is working
+ 		return true;
+ 	} catch (error) {
+ 		console.error("Error connecting to Xata database:", error);
+ 		return false;
+ 	}
+ }

_**Agent**_

We've successfully enhanced the CLI app with a rich terminal user interface! The improvements include:

1. **Interactive Main Menu**:
   - Visually attractive ASCII art header and boxed UI elements
   - Clear workflow diagram showing data processing steps
   - Organized command categories with emoji indicators
   - Easy navigation with list-based menu selection

2. **Category-based Submenus**:
   - Organized commands into thematic areas (Onboarding, Processing, Review, Database)
   - Each submenu has specific options relevant to its functionality
   - Intuitive back navigation to the main menu

3. **Interactive Command Building**:
   - Guides users through command options step-by-step
   - Provides sensible defaults and validation
   - Supports both interactive and batch operations

4. **System Status Dashboard**:
   - Real-time statistics about files in each processing stage
   - Breakdown by data type
   - Database connection status
   - Summary metrics of overall system usage

5. **User Experience Enhancements**:
   - Colorful, visually organized interface
   - Consistent navigation patterns
   - Progress indicators and spinners
   - Emoji icons for better visual recognition
   - Return-to-menu functionality after command execution

The implementation uses several Node.js libraries to create this rich interface:
- **inquirer.js** for interactive prompts and menus
- **chalk** for colorized text output
- **boxen** for creating boxed UI elements
- **figlet** for ASCII art headers
- **ora** for loading spinners

When users launch the CLI without any commands, they'll now see this rich interactive interface instead of just the help text, making the application much more user-friendly and intuitive to use.
